stem: Which sentence can BEST follow and support sentence 11?

options.label: A
options.text: The crier had to walk down long streets during different times of the day.

options.label: B
options.text: Bakers, shoemakers, carpenters, and candlemakers all worked in the village.

options.label: C
options.text: Many village residents were farmers, and they worked the land near the castle.

options.label: D
options.text: The news had to be shouted over and over so everyone could hear it.

visual_elements: Which sentence can BEST follow and support sentence 11?
Ⓐ The crier had to walk down long streets during different times of the day.
